'''Andus Urshant''' was a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] research [[Technician/Legends|technician]] with [[Shankti Drive Works]] in the city of [[D'larah]] on the planet [[Demophon]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was married to [[Zoam Urshant]], and was the father of [[Aklan Urshant]] and [[Fianna Urshant]]. Due to his position he was to be evacuated by Shankti Drive Works from Demophon before that planet was destroyed in a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]], with the rest of his family to be evacuated later. Due to his wife's pregnancy, and her entanglement with the [[G'uotr Network]], he decided to hire a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to evacuate his family and himself earlier.<ref name="TC" />
